advisory.title: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an SQL Command

rankedFiles.title: SQL query built via string concatenation

evidence.note: User-controlled `name` is concatenated into a SQL string before db.query.
evidence.excerpt:
const sql = "SELECT id, name, email FROM users WHERE name = '" + name + "'";
  return db.query(sql);

rankedFiles.title: Request parameter passed to unsafe finder

evidence.note: HTTP query `name` flows into findUserByName without neutralization.
evidence.excerpt:
const name = req.query.name ?? "";
  return findUserByName(db, name);
